acceptance_criteria: All 16 x 67 seed-circuit work units are present with matching configuration and topology hashes.
Every generated tree obeys o=1+2m+r within 1e-12.
The distribution of Figure-9 below-threshold counts is reported per seed; disagreement is retained rather than tuned against author results.
The numerical runner reads only the frozen clean circuit archive under inputs and never raw/, references/, author code, author plans, author result arrays, digitized curves, or source pixels.
